rows.en:
(Alright, another day done!
Maybe I'll stop somewhere on the way home...)
Hey, Alto!

H-huh?
He's gone...
He seemed to be in a hurry. I wonder what's up...?
I'd bet there's a girl behind that.
rows.notes: Are wa onna da na = 'that's (about) a woman'.

rows.en: Whoa! Michel!! Don't just pop up out of nowhere...

It's your own fault for letting someone
get behind you so easily.

So, what about Alto?
You mean he's got a girlfriend or something?

What else could it be? He ignored you calling him
and ran off somewhere.
No way, it's not like he's you, Michel...

You say some pretty rude stuff without even
thinking, you know that?

Anyway, let's go after him.
That'll clear everything up.

W-we're following him?!
That's an invasion of privacy!
Don't tell me you're not curious too.
Well, I am, but...
Then it's settled. Let's go.
Michel, wait up!
So he's meeting someone here, huh?
He really stands out, doesn't he.
rows.notes: Sasuga ni medatteru ne has no subject: read as Alto standing out while he waits at the station; could also be 'we stand out'.

rows.en:
Doesn't look like whoever it is is showing up,
though...
Whoa, he's on the move.
We'd better not get separated...
Now you're getting into it, huh?
rows.notes: Michel teasing the player for getting into the chase.

rows.en: He went into a cafe alone?
Yeah...
Alto... What a lonely guy...
M-maybe this is where he's meeting them!
Who knows...
Ah! He's coming out!!
Let's keep tailing him!
...Griffith Park, huh.
It's kinda hard to hide around here.
...How about you come out already?
Tch, the guy's got good instincts.

I don't wanna hear it from people
who go around tailing others.
Wh-when did you notice?
You were sneaking around all over town.
We were totally obvious, Michel!!
Seems that way...
Michel wasn't even trying to hide.
...He wasn't?
Heh.
So, what are you doing here, Alto?
...Does it matter?
Come on, you could at least tell me...
I just came here to fly one.
rows.notes: Tobashi ni kita = came to fly (something); the player guesses paper airplane next row, so the object stays vague.

rows.en: ...A paper airplane?
That's right.

Then why were you spacing out in front of
the station?

I wasn't spacing out!
I was reading the wind.

Oh, is that all...
That's nothing like what you said, Michel!
Well, it was a good way to kill time, right?
Maybe, but still...
Oh, nothing! Just talking to ourselves!
rows.notes: Kocchi no hanashi, answering Alto's 'What are you talking about?' (c00056) between c00194 and c00195.

rows.en: Well, I'm heading home.
Oh, I'm going home too.
Don't go around tailing people so much.
Okay, sorry!
(Alto sure loves paper airplanes, huh.)
Hey, Saotome-kuuun!

Whoa! Michel-kun!! Don't just pop up out of
nowhere...

So, what about Saotome-kun?
You mean he's got a girlfriend or something?
No way, it's not like he's you, Michel-kun...
Michel-kun, wait up!
He really stands out, huh.
Yeah...
We were totally obvious, Michel-kun!!
So, what are you doing here, Saotome-kun?
Oh, come on, you could tell me...

Oh, is that all...
That's nothing like what you said!
Oh, I'm going home too.
(Saotome-kun sure loves paper airplanes, doesn't he.)

uncertain: c00159/c00206: subjectless 'sasuga ni medatteru' read as Alto standing out at the station; could mean the two trackers stand out.
